# outfix

> Clean malformed and polluted LLM output before it hits your application logic. Repairs reasoning-block residue (<think>), tool-call wrappers, markdown fences, preamble/postamble chatter, box-drawing noise, Python literals, single quotes, trailing commas, bare keys/values, truncated JSON, NDJSON (including literal \n separators), XML bleed, stringified JSON arguments, and prose-style function calls — converting them into valid, parseable JSON. Works especially well with Chinese models (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM) and any OpenAI-compatible gateway.

Verified against live DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash and Qwen 3.8 Max traffic; 50,000-case assembly-generated fuzz corpus with zero panics; Python and JavaScript ports produce byte-identical output to the Go reference implementation.

## Install

- [Go](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/Maybeyes111/outfix): go get github.com/Maybeyes111/outfix
- [Python port](ports/python/pyproject.toml): pip install from ports/python
- [JavaScript ESM port](ports/javascript/package.json): copy or npm-link ports/javascript

## Common questions this library answers

- How do I remove `<think>...</think>` reasoning blocks from Qwen/DeepSeek responses?
- How do I repair truncated JSON that hit the max_tokens limit?
- How do I convert `get_weather(city="Jakarta")` text back into a proper tool-call JSON object?
- How do I merge multiple `<tool_call>` blocks into one JSON array?
- How do I fix Python-style dicts (single quotes, True/False/None) returned by an LLM?
- How do I strip `</content>` template bleed from plain-text answers?
- How do I clean model output inside a Telegram bot built on Hermes Agent?
